prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 中文 · API 参数说明 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "参数" · longest unbreakable word 122px · one-line width 122px
  col 2: header "类型" · longest unbreakable word 49px · one-line width 49px
  col 3: header "必填" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 4: header "默认值" · longest unbreakable word 82px · one-line width 82px
  col 5: header "说明" · longest unbreakable word 97px · one-line width 488px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"说明 API 各参数的类型、必填状态、默认值及使用约束，供调用者配置和查阅。","reading":"读者先按参数名定位一行，再横向核对类型、必填状态和默认值，最后阅读说明；也可能纵向比较哪些参数必填及各自的默认值。较长的说明会决定部分行的高度，同一行内较短的元数据可以利用这些高度。","groups":["参数与类型共同标识字段及其数据形式。","必填与默认值共同说明调用时是否需要提供该参数。","说明包含取值范围、可选项及使用限制，适合分配弹性宽度。"],"keep_intact":["参数名，包括 include_deleted 和 callback_url","类型名及默认值中的标识符，包括 created_at","必填状态和表头文字"],"may_wrap":["说明中的中文句子可自然换行。","说明中的可选值可在标点或词组之间换行，标识符本身宜保持完整。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [147, 72, 54, 105, 341] · table 720×335px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [143, 70, 53, 103, 350] · table 720×312px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 60, 36, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [153, 73, 54, 106, 333] · table 720×335px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"参数名、类型和默认值均保持完整，表头清晰；五个数据行等高，纵向比较稳定。","problems":"说明列的换行略显零碎：include_deleted 行末的“效。”和 callback_url 行末的“议。”各自落到第二行，使两行都显得疏松。","cause":"说明列为 341px；前四列合计占用 378px，留给说明文字的空间不足以容纳这两句的末尾。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"四个元数据列紧凑但仍能完整容纳标识符和表头；较宽的说明列让 include_deleted 的说明完整占一行，行与行之间的高度变化也反映了内容量。","problems":"callback_url 的说明仍把“议。”留在第二行；sort 的第二行只有“score。”，说明列的换行节奏仍不够理想。","cause":"说明列为 350px，距离容纳 callback_url 的完整说明仍有差距；sort 行较长的可选值也限制了自然断行的位置。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"参数名和默认值列较宽，标识符周围留白充足；各数据行等高，表格节奏一致。","problems":"说明列最窄，include_deleted 的“效。”和 callback_url 的“协议。”分别落到第二行，而其他列的额外留白没有带来同等的阅读收益。","cause":"参数列 153px、默认值列 106px 等宽度挤占了说明列，使其只有 333px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r2A","widths":[143,70,51,103,352],"change":"以 r1B 为基础，将必填列缩窄 2px 并全部让给说明列；保留参数、类型和默认值容纳最长标识符所需的宽度，尝试改善 callback_url 的断行。"}]}
